mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in the GDP Chain Price Index (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals a demand-driven inflationary pressure that leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above trend does not correlate with positive SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines below trend do not precede negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS above 4.5% does not precede negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03, the hypothesis is falsified.
